#!/bin/bash
set -e

source /etc/network_turbo 2>/dev/null || true
source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh
conda activate base
export HF_HOME=/root/autodl-tmp/.hf_cache
export HF_HUB_DISABLE_XET=1
export REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE=/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt
export SSL_CERT_FILE=/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt

PARQUET_DIR="/root/autodl-tmp/fineweb_data"
mkdir -p "$PARQUET_DIR"

FILE_014="$PARQUET_DIR/014_00000.parquet"
FILE_000="$PARQUET_DIR/000_00000.parquet"
TARGET_SIZE_014=575038542
TARGET_SIZE_000=2147311840

# Wait for 014 to finish downloading
echo "$(date): Waiting for 014_00000.parquet download..."
while true; do
    if [ -f "$FILE_014" ]; then
        SIZE=$(stat -c%s "$FILE_014" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
        if [ "$SIZE" -ge "$TARGET_SIZE_014" ]; then
            echo "$(date): 014_00000.parquet complete ($SIZE bytes)"
            break
        fi
        echo "$(date): 014 progress: $SIZE / $TARGET_SIZE_014 bytes"
    fi
    sleep 10
done

# Kill old 000 wget if still stuck, restart it
pkill -f "wget.*000_00000" 2>/dev/null || true
sleep 2

echo "$(date): Starting 000_00000.parquet download..."
wget --continue -O "$FILE_000" \
    "https://huggingface.co/datasets/HuggingFaceFW/fineweb/resolve/main/sample/10BT/000_00000.parquet" \
    > /tmp/wget_000_v2.log 2>&1 &
WGET_PID=$!
echo "$(date): wget PID=$WGET_PID"

# Process probe+val while 000 downloads
echo "$(date): Processing probe+val from 014..."
python3 /root/prism_collapse_mixing/prepare_data.py --phase1-only 2>&1 || {
    echo "$(date): Phase 1 failed, trying full run..."
}

# Wait for 000 download
echo "$(date): Waiting for 000_00000.parquet download..."
while true; do
    if [ -f "$FILE_000" ]; then
        SIZE=$(stat -c%s "$FILE_000" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
        if [ "$SIZE" -ge "$TARGET_SIZE_000" ]; then
            echo "$(date): 000_00000.parquet complete ($SIZE bytes)"
            break
        fi
        PCTG=$((SIZE * 100 / TARGET_SIZE_000))
        echo "$(date): 000 progress: ${PCTG}% ($SIZE / $TARGET_SIZE_000 bytes)"
    fi
    # Check if wget is still running
    if ! ps -p $WGET_PID > /dev/null 2>&1; then
        SIZE=$(stat -c%s "$FILE_000" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
        if [ "$SIZE" -ge "$TARGET_SIZE_000" ]; then
            echo "$(date): 000_00000.parquet complete ($SIZE bytes)"
            break
        else
            echo "$(date): ERROR: wget died but file incomplete ($SIZE bytes). Retrying..."
            wget --continue -O "$FILE_000" \
                "https://huggingface.co/datasets/HuggingFaceFW/fineweb/resolve/main/sample/10BT/000_00000.parquet" \
                > /tmp/wget_000_v2.log 2>&1 &
            WGET_PID=$!
        fi
    fi
    sleep 30
done

# Process train
echo "$(date): Processing train from 000..."
python3 /root/prism_collapse_mixing/prepare_data.py 2>&1

echo "$(date): Pipeline complete!"
BASH_EOF
chmod +x /root/prism_collapse_mixing/run_pipeline.sh
echo "Pipeline script written OK"

import json, os, time
import pyarrow.parquet as pq
from transformers import AutoTokenizer

DATA_DIR = '/root/prism_collapse_mixing/data'
os.makedirs(DATA_DIR, exist_ok=True)

print('Loading tokenizer...', flush=True)
tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained('EleutherAI/pythia-410m-deduped', cache_dir='/root/autodl-tmp/.hf_cache')

PV_FILE = '/root/autodl-tmp/fineweb_data/014_00000.parquet'
print(f'Reading {PV_FILE}...', flush=True)
t0 = time.time()
table = pq.read_table(PV_FILE, columns=['text'])
texts = table.column('text')
print(f'  {len(texts)} rows loaded ({time.time()-t0:.0f}s)', flush=True)
del table

PROBE_SIZE = 5000
PROBE_TOKEN_LEN = 256
VAL_TARGET = 10_000_000

# Probe
probe_count = 0
pv_idx = 0
with open(os.path.join(DATA_DIR, 'probe_set.jsonl'), 'w') as f:
    for i in range(len(texts)):
        text = texts[i].as_py()
        if not text or not text.strip():
            continue
        tokens = tokenizer.encode(text, add_special_tokens=False)
        if len(tokens) >= PROBE_TOKEN_LEN:
            trunc = tokens[:PROBE_TOKEN_LEN]
            f.write(json.dumps({'text': tokenizer.decode(trunc), 'token_count': PROBE_TOKEN_LEN}) + '\n')
            probe_count += 1
            if probe_count % 1000 == 0:
                print(f'  Probe: {probe_count}/{PROBE_SIZE}', flush=True)
            if probe_count >= PROBE_SIZE:
                pv_idx = i + 1
                break

print(f'Probe: {probe_count} samples, {probe_count*PROBE_TOKEN_LEN:,} tokens ({time.time()-t0:.0f}s)', flush=True)

# Val
val_count = 0
val_tokens = 0
with open(os.path.join(DATA_DIR, 'val_set.jsonl'), 'w') as f:
    for i in range(pv_idx, len(texts)):
        if val_tokens >= VAL_TARGET:
            break
        text = texts[i].as_py()
        if not text or not text.strip():
            continue
        tokens = tokenizer.encode(text, add_special_tokens=False)
        n = len(tokens)
        f.write(json.dumps({'text': text}) + '\n')
        val_count += 1
        val_tokens += n
        if val_count % 5000 == 0:
            print(f'  Val: {val_count} samples, {val_tokens/1e6:.1f}M tokens', flush=True)

print(f'Val: {val_count} samples, {val_tokens:,} tokens ({val_tokens/1e6:.1f}M) ({time.time()-t0:.0f}s)', flush=True)

for fname in ['probe_set.jsonl', 'val_set.jsonl']:
    fpath = os.path.join(DATA_DIR, fname)
    print(f'  {fname}: {os.path.getsize(fpath)/1e6:.1f} MB', flush=True)

print('Phase 1 DONE', flush=True)
"
